commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
For one with the fortune to rule the land, these three never leave: speed in the matters at hand, the learning to understand them, and manliness. Manliness means doing a thing quickly, looking at nothing else, so it is called resolve here. Learning serves all six limbs, and the others serve action.

தூங்காமை is literally not sleeping. He reads it as not delaying.
